name: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited

facts.business: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited (POWERGRID) is engaged in the transmission of electricity, consultancy, project management, supervision, and telecom services.

segments.name: Consultancy, Project Management and Supervision Fees

key_risks: Board composition non-compliance due to vacant Independent Director positions including Independent Woman Director
Non-compliance with composition requirements of Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders' Relationship Committee, Risk Management Committee and CSR Committee
Quorum requirement non-compliance for Board meetings
Fines imposed by NSE and BSE for non-compliance
facts.related_party_note: Corporate Guarantee extended to Banks to facilitate hedging of foreign currency exposure of POWERGRID West Central Transmission Limited (Wholly Owned Subsidiary). Inter-corporate loan to POWERTEL up to ₹36.35 crore for Wi-Fi Deployment. Consultancy services for NHAI project with project cost ₹3.74 crore and consultancy fee @13% - ₹0.48 crore + GST.
